metadata.title: Smuggler Exchange
metadata.description: Board a collapsing black-market exchange, decide whether to stabilize Veil's wounded safehouse or strip the vault, and leave before patrol evidence-burners sweep the station.
metadata.objectiveText: OBJECTIVE: Access Broker Veil's uplink, unseal the vault, secure either the safehouse wounded or the route cache, and choose how your fleet leaves the exchange before patrols converge.
metadata.promptText: Controls: left click an officer to select, left click a floor tile to move, TAB or 1-2 to switch officers, middle mouse drag or WASD to pan, mouse wheel or +/- to zoom, ESC to abort. Use the broker uplink, vault override, safehouse medbay, and patrol scrubber to unlock your final choice.

logic.label: Broker Veil Uplink Console
logic.notes: Veil's live uplink with the broker's terms and casualties.

logic.label: Patrol Feed Scrubber
logic.notes: Scrubs incoming patrol telemetry and exposes the hard exit window.

logic.label: Vault Override Console
logic.notes: Unseals the route-cache vault once Veil's briefing is understood.

logic.label: Safehouse Medbay
logic.notes: Stabilize Veil's wounded and commit them to extraction.

logic.label: NPC: Broker Veil
logic.notes: Visual anchor for Broker Veil in the exchange hub.

logic.label: NPC: Safehouse Medtech
logic.notes: Visual anchor for the medtech managing the wounded.
